summary: Discreet one-line text next to the crosshair: above, below, left or right of it, in four sizes.

positions.doc: Position codes the layout has a label for: t above, b below, l left, r right (TargetLayout.Positions).

panels.doc: The label. Author it with class `hidden`. The layout keeps it beside the screen centre. `size-sm`, `size-md`, `size-lg`, `size-xl` set the text size.
